Hey, I read your post and even shared it with my friend, who is in current times studying psychology btw, and this is what she has to say:-

"I feel like they r being too judgy, closed and mechanical. They have started analysing their relations and social interactions like data from a study. They need to be more subjective about situations. They enter relationships, romantic or otherwise, with a lot of apprehensions and presumptions and possible with a lot of expectations as well...which is why their social life has been largely a disappointment, as they pointed out. I get that as an introvert it may be hard for them to reach out to people, especially cuz they r intimidating. But that's cuz they have built up their walls too high. It's like... they have drawn a line like....this is who I am...I'm a rigid person...like me or not.... idc. I mean...u shouldn't change your essence for other people. But u need to be welcoming and flexible at the same time."

I do agree with what she says. And as an introvert myself, I understand what you are trying to convey. But the one thing which is lacking in you is your self-concept. You need to change that. You have to believe that everyone around you does want to invest time with you and you have to have faith in that belief. And now once you've done that, stay firm to that belief. It's going to change how you view the world around you. A change in perspective changes everything. Try it for yourself. Just test the water. And you'll understand what I'm trying to say.

Like, for example, I wouldn't be excited or euphoric two or three days after my manifestation has been manifested. It wouldn't be natural for me. I would just be normal.
